.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/husky.name: Before-push execution checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/husky.description: Runs the shipped before-push script and checks its required gates.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/inser.name: Table formatting helper checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/inser.description: Checks that the table helper preserves formatting without adding duplicate ignore markers.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/machi.name: Machine lock behavior checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/machi.description: Runs the shared machine lock with real processes to check exclusive access and cleanup.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/mcp-t.name: GitHub tool access checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/mcp-t.description: Checks that GitHub assistant connections include the tools needed for automated-check evidence.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/secre.name: Secret synchronization checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/secre.description: Checks the shipped tool for comparing and updating remote secret settings.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/setti.name: Command approval settings checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/setti.description: Checks that shipped Claude settings avoid content-specific download approval rules.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/slop-.name: Type-check bypass detection checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/slop-.description: Runs the code-quality scanner to check detection of type-check bypasses and scoped exceptions.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/telem.name: Measurement merge settings checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/telem.description: Uses Git's attribute resolver to check the merge handling of measurement records.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/templ.name: Automation version pin checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/templ.description: Checks that shipped automation templates pin external actions to specific revisions.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/templ.name: Project check workflow checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/templ.description: Checks that the filled project workflow is valid and its final status can be found by shipping commands.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/templ.name: Portable template path checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/templ.description: Checks that plan templates contain no developer-machine absolute paths.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/templ.name: Template reference boundary checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/templ.description: Checks that workflows and prompts do not depend directly on copy-and-own template paths.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/templ.name: Document template shape checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/templ.description: Checks that plan and audit templates define the required document structure.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/templ.name: Seeded template content checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/templ.description: Checks the rendered contents of files seeded into consumer projects.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/templ.name: Template ownership checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/templ.description: Checks managed markers and content requirements across shipped templates.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/tmp-p.name: Temporary file cleanup checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/tmp-p.description: Checks the shipped temporary-directory cleanup script before projects adopt it.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/workf.name: Cloud and check workflow tests
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/workf.description: Checks the shipped cloud and project automation workflow templates.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/auto-.name: Feature identifier safety checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/auto-.description: Checks that automatic routing validates feature identifiers and rejects injected commands or paths.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/block.name: Self-contained shell block checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/block.description: Checks that each documented shell block defines the variables it uses.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/catal.name: Workflow catalog equality checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/catal.description: Checks that workflow and agent catalogs agree with their source files.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/ci-di.name: Remote check gate alignment
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/ci-di.description: Checks that workflows use the required remote-check dispatch and shipping revalidation gates.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/close.name: Workflow closing execution checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/close.description: Runs design and plan closing steps against a real temporary repository and remote.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/compl.name: Closing compliance checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/compl.description: Checks that workflow closing gates invoke the required compliance checks.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/count.name: Attempt counter instruction checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/count.description: Checks that workflow instructions derive attempt counts through the supported record commands.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/debug.name: Debug evidence execution checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/debug.description: Runs debug evidence collection with the built command-line tool, Git history and project checks.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/gener.name: Generated comment boundary checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/gener.description: Checks the markers that separate generated tracker comments from later workflow inputs.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/local.name: Project gate instruction checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/local.description: Checks that instructions call declared project gate scripts instead of duplicating their commands.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/model.name: Model preset documentation checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/model.description: Checks that repeated model summaries agree with the model table read by the installer.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/model.name: Agent model table checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/model.description: Checks that the model table agrees with the agent prompt declarations.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/owner.name: Owner waiting record checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/owner.description: Checks that workflow pauses for the owner write the required waiting records.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/promp.name: Prompt notation checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/promp.description: Checks the notation used in shipped agent instructions.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/quest.name: Owner question layout checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/quest.description: Checks that questions present their answer options in one consistent format.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/runti.name: Runtime instruction presence checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/runti.description: Checks that workflow text includes the required runtime capability guidance.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/ship-.name: Shipping contract checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/ship-.description: Checks shipping instructions for the required push, staging and step-record contracts.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/ship-.name: Shipping outcome execution checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/ship-.description: Runs shipping outcome handling with real shell commands and the built roadmap reader.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/skip-.name: Commit check marker checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/skip-.description: Checks that instructions apply automated-check suppression markers only in the required commit form.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/slash.name: Command argument substitution checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/slash.description: Checks that rendered assistant commands preserve safe argument substitution.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/telem.name: Workflow measurement wiring checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/telem.description: Checks that workflow instructions call the required measurement writers.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/text-.name: Command output contract checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/text-.description: Checks that workflows do not read fields omitted from a command's default text output.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/untru.name: External evidence boundary checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/untru.description: Checks that fetched external text carries one complete untrusted-input boundary.
